verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। उत्थायावश्यकार्याणि कृतवान् भ्रातृभिः सह॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : The night being spent, Yudhishthira, the foremost of the virtuous awoke and performed the necessary duties together with his brothers.

verses.sanskrit: ततः सञ्चोदयामास सोर्जुनं मातृनन्दनम्। दर्शयास्त्राणि कौन्तेय यैर्जिता दानवास्त्वया॥२॥
verses.english: Then he (Yudhishthira) said to Arjuna, the joy of his mother, “O son of Kunti, show me the weapons whereby you destroyed the Danavas."

verses.sanskrit: ततो धनञ्जयो राजन् देवैर्दत्तानि पाण्डवः। अस्त्राणि तानि दिव्यानि दर्शयामास भारत॥३॥
verses.english: Thereupon, O king, O Bharata, the Pandava, Arjuna showed those celestials weapons granted (to him) by the god,

verses.sanskrit: यथान्यायं महातेजाः शौचं परममास्थितः। गिरिकूबरपादाक्षं शुभवेणु त्रिवेणुमत्॥४॥
verses.english: (And) duly observing the purificatory rites, the highly-energetic Dhananjaya, seated on the earth as (his) car, having the mountain for its pole, the base of the mountain for its axle and the cluster of beautiful bamboo trees for its socket pole and clad in that celestials mail of great splendour, looked (highly) beautiful.

verses.sanskrit: पार्थिवं रथमास्थाय शोभमानो धनञ्जयः। दिव्येन संवृतस्तेन कवचेन सुवर्चसा॥५॥
verses.bhavadeepa: अस्त्राणि दर्शयितुमिच्छोरर्जुनस्य भावनामाह गिरीति । गिरय एव कूबरादयस्तद्वन्तम् । कूबरो यस्मिन् युगं ध्रियते तद्दारु । पादौ चक्रे । अक्षः तयोः सन्धानदारु । शुभाः वेणव इव वेणवो यस्मिन् तत् शुभवेणु । त्रिवेणु - अक्षकूबरयोः सन्धानार्थं त्रिशिखं दारु तद्वन्तम् । ‘सुपां सुलुक्-’ इति द्वितीयाया आर्षो लुक्। रथपदे वा क्लीबत्वं ध्येयम् ॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: धनुरादाय गाण्डीवं देवदत्तं स वारिजम्। शोशुभ्यमानः कौन्तेय आनुपूर्व्यान्महाभुजः॥६॥
verses.english: (And)o son of Kunti, the handsome (Dhananjaya) of mighty arms, holding (in his hand) the bow Gandiva, together with the conch presented to him by the celestials, was about to exhibit in due order those celestials weapons. (But) As he commenced to display those heavenly weapons,
verses.bhavadeepa: पृथिवीमेव पार्थिवं मानसं भूमिरूपं रथम् । राक्षसवायसादिवत् स्वार्थे तद्धितः । आस्थाय ध्यानबलेन आरुह्य । दिव्येन इन्द्रदत्तेन ॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्राणि तानि दिव्यानि दर्शनायोपचक्रमे। अथ प्रयोक्ष्यमाणेषु दिव्येष्वस्त्रेषु तेषु वै॥७॥
समाक्रान्ता मही पद्भ्यां समकम्पत सद्रुमा। क्षुभिताः सरितश्चैव तथैव च महोदधिः॥८॥
verses.english: The earth, being oppressed by the weight of his feet, began to tremble together with all its trees and the rivers and the mighty ocean became troubled.

verses.sanskrit: शैलाश्चापि व्यदीर्यन्त न ववौ च समीरणः। न बभासे सहस्रांशुर्न जज्वाल च पावकः॥९॥
verses.english: The mountain were rent, the wind ceased to blow, the sun ceased to shine, the fire did not burn,
verses.bhavadeepa: अर्जुनेन अनेकब्रह्माण्डगर्भस्य महादेवस्य साम्यं भावनाबलाद्गतेन समाक्रान्ता पृथिवी समकम्पत॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: न वेदाः प्रतिभान्ति स्म द्विजातीनां कथञ्चन। अन्तर्भूमिगता ये च प्राणिनो जनमेजय॥१०॥
verses.english: And the twice-born (Brahmanas) could by no means recite the Vedas. And O Janamejaya, the creatures inhabiting the entrails of the earth,

verses.sanskrit: पीड्यमानाः समुत्थाय पाण्डवं पर्यवारयन्। वेपमानाः प्राञ्जलयस्ते सर्वे विकृताननाः॥११॥
verses.english: Being (sore) oppressed, rose up and with distorted countenances and joined hands and trembling (with fear), surrounded the Pandava (Arjuna).

verses.sanskrit: दह्यमानास्तदाऽस्त्रैस्ते याचन्ति स्म धनञ्जयम्। ततो ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव सिद्धा ये च महर्षयः॥१२॥
verses.english: And scorched by those (celestials) weapons they prayed to Dhananjaya (to spare their lives). Then the Brahmarshis, the Siddhas, the Maharshis,

verses.sanskrit: जङ्गमानि च भूतानि सर्वाण्येवावतस्थिरे। देवर्षयश्च प्रवरास्तथैव च दिवौकसः॥१३॥
verses.english: And the mobile beings-all these creatures arrived there. The most exalted Devarshis, the celestials,

verses.sanskrit: यक्षराक्षसगन्धर्वास्तथैव च पतत्त्रिणः। खेचराणि च भूतानि सर्वाण्येवावतस्थिरे॥१४॥
verses.english: The Yakshas, the Rakshasas, the Gandharvas, the feathery creatures, the skyranging creatures-all these beings appeared (on the scene).

verses.sanskrit: ततः पितामहश्चैव लोकपालाश्च सर्वशः। भगवांश्च महादेवः सगणोऽभ्याययौ तदा॥१५॥
verses.english: Then Pitamaha (Brahma), all the Lokapalas (the guardians of the ten cardinal points), the divine Mahadeva, together with all their followers, made their appearance (at that spot).

verses.sanskrit: ततो वायुर्महाराज दिव्यैर्माल्यैः समन्वितः। अभितः पाण्डवं चित्रैरवचक्रे समन्ततः॥१६॥
verses.english: (And) then, O mighty monarch, Vayu (the wind-god) bearing bearing variegated celestials flowers, began to strew them all around the Pandava (Arjuna).

verses.sanskrit: जगुश्च गाथा विविधा गन्धर्वाः सुरचोदिताः। ननृतुः सङ्घशश्चैव राजन्नप्सरसां गणाः॥१७॥
verses.english: O king, commissioned by the gods, the Gandharvas sang various melodies and multitudes of Apsaras danced there.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिंश्च तादृशे काले नारदश्चोदितः सुरैः। आगम्याह वचः पार्थं श्रवणीयमिदं नृप॥१८॥
verses.english: (And)O king, at that very time, Narada, sent by the celestials, arrived (there) and spoke to Partha these words grateful to the ear:

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनार्जुन मा युङ्क्ष्व दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि भारत। नैतानि निरधिष्ठाने प्रयुज्यन्ते कथञ्चन॥१९॥
verses.english: "O Arjuna, O Bharata, forebear discharging these celestials weapons. These (weapons) ought, by no means, to be hurled where there is no object to hit at.

verses.sanskrit: अधिष्ठाने न वाऽनार्तः प्रयुञ्जीत कदाचन। प्रयोगेषु महान् दोषो ह्यस्त्राणां कुरुनन्दन॥२०॥
verses.english: And unless sore afflicted, one should not discharge these even if there is an object (present). O descendant of the Kurus, it will result in a terrible disaster, if these weapons are (causclessly) discharged.

verses.sanskrit: एतानि रक्ष्यमाणानि धनञ्जय यथागमम्। बलवन्ति सुखार्हाणि भविष्यन्ति न संशयः॥२१॥
verses.english: O Dhananjaya, if these powerful weapons are duly kept, they will no doubt, lead to your happiness.

verses.sanskrit: अरक्ष्यमाणान्येतानि त्रैलोक्यस्यापि पाण्डव। भवन्ति स्म विनाशाय मैवं भूयः कृथाः क्वचित्॥२२॥
verses.english: (But), O Pandava, if they are not (carefully) preserved, they will lead to the destruction of the three worlds. Therefore, do not attempt such a (rash) act again.

verses.sanskrit: अजातशत्रो त्वं चैव द्रक्ष्यसे तानि संयुगे। योज्यमानानि पार्थेन द्विषतामवमर्दने॥२३॥
verses.english: O Ajatashatru (Yudhishthira), you will behold them when Partha will make use of them for the destruction of your enemies in battle."

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              निवार्याथ ततः पार्थं सर्वे देवा यथागतम्। जग्मुरन्ये च ये तत्र समाजग्मुर्नरर्षभ॥२४॥
verses.english: O the most exalted of mortals, having prevented Arjuna (from hurling these weapons), all the celestials and all other beings who had come there went to their respective abodes.

verses.sanskrit: तेषु सर्वेषु कौरव्य प्रतियातेषु पाण्डवाः। तस्मिन्नेव वने हृष्टास्त ऊषुः सह कृष्णया॥२५॥
verses.english: O descendant of the Kurus, when all those had taken their departure, the Pandavas, together with Krishna, began to dwell cheerfully in that forest.
